discussion.body:
Name correction plus office.
Spoken "Vorath" in the Act 13 ask. Locked name is Vortan. Do not mint Vorath. Do not rename this ticket.
User rewrite: Vortan is the previous God of Life. Forge-King / World Cannon / undeath remains the living mask. The Cannon aiming at Fire is what that office did after it stopped being harvest.
Face order unchanged: Velith, Vortan, Nyxara. He is still not automatically the Act 13 last fight (see FEAT-044 open last-body). Act 10 hunt and Act 12 mid-confrontation still exist if a body remains after Act 7.
